tools.install: winget install Git.Git   (Git for Windows; the probe is tested against it)
winget install Rustlang.Rustup   (then: rustup default stable-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc)
winget install astral-sh.uv   (runs make_large_tree.py and extract_failures.py)
winget install NASM.NASM   (the aws-lc-sys crates in quarto-hub need it)
winget install Kitware.CMake   (the aws-lc-sys crates in quarto-hub need it)
Visual Studio Build Tools, "Desktop development with C++" (cargo finds link.exe itself, so absent from PATH is normal; install only if the build says "linker not found")
fnm/nvm; Node major per .nvmrc (items b1 to b7)
optional: winget install jj-vcs.jj (the jj scenarios of b1 skip without it)
